digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow - macOS test execution
propositions: Hypothesis: moving macOS pytest temporary Git repositories from runner.temp to an ephemeral APFS RAM disk would reduce Gerrit Verify critical-path wall time by at least 5% or the observed recent-green range
Exact no-RAM control run 31868300174 completed macOS default suite in 17m26s and full macOS job in 20m36s with identical 13,397 passed / 65 skipped collection counts

Four independent RAM-disk treatment runs (31869753711, 31869919362, 31870391571, 31873067707) all exceeded control baseline with default suite times of 18m43s, 20m54s, 18m26s, and 20m00s respectively, failing the predeclared retention threshold

RAM-disk lifecycle added 71-98 seconds of recursive observability and cleanup overhead, exposing intentionally owner-nonwritable workflow snapshot fixtures that caused PermissionError during basetemp removal

Experiment rejected and reverted: storage placement to RAM disk did not reduce wall time, implementation was removed, both pytest tiers restored to runner.temp, and test isolation contracts for snapshot cleanup and nested cacheprovider were separately repaired and merged
